questions.question: The area of a trapezium shaped field is 1720 m², the distance between its parallel sides is 40 m and the length of one of the parallel sides is 48 m. What is the length (in m) of the other parallel side?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Sum of parallel sides = (2 × Area) ÷ Height

⇒ 48 + b = (2 × 1720) ÷ 40

⇒ 48 + b = 3440 ÷ 40 = 86

⇒ b = 86 − 48 = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38 m.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Area of trapezium = 1720 m²

Distance between parallel sides (h) = 40 m

Length of one parallel side (a) = 48 m

Let the other parallel side be b.

 

 
• 
 

 b = ?
 a = 48 m
 h = 40 m
 Area = 1720 m²

**Formula Used:**

Area of trapezium = 1/2 × (Sum of parallel sides) × Height

**Calculations:**

⇒ 1720 = 1/2 × (48 + b) × 40

⇒ 1720 = 20 × (48 + b)

⇒ 48 + b = 1720 ÷ 20

⇒ 48 + b = 86

⇒ b = 86 − 48

⇒ b = 38

**∴ The correct answer is 38 m.**

**__Additional Information__**

Area of a Trapezium

The area is half the product of the sum of parallel sides and the perpendicular distance between them. Formula: A = 1/2 × (a + b) × h

Perimeter of a Trapezium

The sum of all four sides of the trapezium. Perimeter = a + b + c + d, where a and b are the parallel sides, and c and d are the non-parallel sides.

Isosceles Trapezium

A trapezium in which the non-parallel sides are equal in length. The base angles are equal, and its diagonals are also equal in length.

Median of a Trapezium

The line segment connecting the midpoints of the non-parallel sides. Length of median = 1/2 × (a + b).

questions.question: Ram can do a piece of work in 18 hours. Shyam and Naresh can do it in 9 hours. Ram and Naresh can do it in 12 hours. How long will Shyam alone take to do it?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Assume **Total Work** = LCM(18, 9, 12) = 36 units.

Efficiency: **Ram** = 2, **Shyam + Naresh** = 4, **Ram + Naresh** = 3.

Efficiency of **Naresh** = (Ram + Naresh) − Ram = 3 − 2 = 1.

Efficiency of **Shyam** = (Shyam + Naresh) − Naresh = 4 − 1 = 3.

Time for **Shyam** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency = 36 ÷ 3 = 12 hr.

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hr.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **Ram** = 18 hr

Time taken by **Shyam and Naresh** = 9 hr

Time taken by **Ram and Naresh** = 12 hr

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Time × Efficiency

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of **Naresh (N)** = Efficiency(R + N) − Efficiency(R)

⇒ Efficiency of **N** = 3 − 2 = 1 unit/hr

⇒ Efficiency of **Shyam (S)** = Efficiency(S + N) − Efficiency(N)

⇒ Efficiency of **S** = 4 − 1 = 3 units/hr

⇒ Time taken by **Shyam** alone = Total Work ÷ Efficiency of **S**

⇒ Time = 36 ÷ 3 = 12 hr

**∴ The correct answer is 12 hr.**

**__Additional Information__**

Efficiency and Time Relationship

The time taken to complete a work is **inversely proportional** to the efficiency of the person. Time = Work ÷ Efficiency.

Combined Work Formula

If A takes X days and B takes Y days, together they take (X × Y) ÷ (X + Y) days to complete the work.

Work and Wages

Wages are distributed in the **ratio of the efficiency** (or the ratio of the work done) by each individual.</p

questions.question: If (x - 2) is a factor of (2x2 + 12kx - 25k), then what is the value of k?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x - 2) is a factor of 2x² + 12kx - 25k.

**Formula Used:**

If (x - a) is a factor of a polynomial, then the polynomial will equal zero when x = a.

**Calculation:**

Let's substitute x = 2 in the polynomial 2x² + 12kx - 25k.

⇒ 2(2)² + 12k(2) - 25k = 0

⇒ 8 + 24k - 25k = 0

⇒ 8 - k = 0

⇒ k = 8

**Therefore, the value of k is 8.**

questions.question: A 360 m long train running at the speed of 108 km/h crosses another train running in the opposite direction at the speed of 90 km/h in 12 seconds. What is the length (in m) of the other train?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative Speed in opposite direction = 108 + 90 = 198 km/h.

Speed in m/s = 198 × (5/18) = 55 m/s.

Total distance covered in 12 seconds = 55 × 12 = 660 m.

Length of the other train = Total distance − Length of first train.

Length = 660 − 360 = 300 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 m.**

Q = 60 ÷ 15 = 4

⇒ 10 × 6 = 60

Direct Proportion

Two quantities are in direct proportion if an increase in one leads to a proportional increase in the other (y/x = k or y₁/x₁ = y₂/x₂).

Proportionality Constant

The value k is known as the constant of proportionality, which relates the two variables in any state of the relationship.</p

questions.question: Which of the following statements is correct about Article 129 of the Constitution of India?

options.text: It provides for the Supreme Court to give advisory opinion to the President.
It provides for the Supreme Court to be a court of original jurisdiction
It provides for the Supreme Court to be a court of record.
It provides for the Supreme Court to be the highest court of appeal.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **It provides for the Supreme Court to be a court of record.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 129** of the Constitution of India declares the Supreme Court to be a **court of record**. This status grants it two main powers: the power to punish for contempt of itself and the power to have its judgments recorded for perpetual memory and testimony.
 
• The option stating **"It provides for the Supreme Court to give advisory opinion to the President"** refers to **Article 143**, not Article 129, hence it is incorrect.
 
• The option that mentions **"It provides for the Supreme Court to be a court of original jurisdiction"** partially describes Article 131, which deals with the original jurisdiction of the Supreme Court but does not fully encapsulate the provisions of Article 129. Therefore, it is not the best answer in this context.
 
• The statement about the Supreme Court being the **"highest court of appeal"** is true but is a more general characteristic of the Supreme Court and not specific to Article 129.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Supreme Court of India** has a wide range of functions and powers under the Constitution, including original jurisdiction, appellate jurisdiction, and advisory functions.
 
• As a **court of record**, the Supreme Court's judgments are of evidentiary value and cannot be questioned when produced before any court. They are recognized as legal precedents and sources of law.
 
• The role of the Supreme Court as the **highest court of appeal** covers appeals in civil, criminal, and constitutional cases, ensuring a unified interpretation of the law across India.

Hence, the statement about **Article 129** providing for the Supreme Court to be a court of record is correct
